facts.text: Hotel Amigo is between the Grand-Place and Manneken Pis in Brussels.
facts.excerpt: Between the Grand-Place and Manneken Pis, amid a celebrated history and contemporary life

facts.text: The hotel's building is over 500 years old.
facts.excerpt: history is serious here: the building is over 500 years old

facts.text: Ristorante Bocconi serves authentic Italian cuisine as envisioned by chef Fulvio Pierangelini.
facts.excerpt: honest, authentic Italian cuisine as envisioned by Fulvio Pierangelini

facts.text: In Bocconi's dining room, custom Adam Ellis artwork pays tribute to Italy's theatrical heritage with figures from the Commedia dell'Arte.
facts.excerpt: In our light-filled dining room, custom Adam Ellis artwork pays tribute to Italy

facts.text: Monochrome Fornasetti plates in individually painted frames decorate Bocconi's walls.
facts.excerpt: Signature monochrome plates by visionary Fornasetti decorate the walls in individually painted frames

facts.text: Bocconi has a Milan-inspired terrace for aperitivo and Italian dining.
facts.excerpt: Linger on our Milan-inspired terrace, where aperitivo flows into refined Italian cuisine.

facts.text: Bocconi serves a Pranzo della Domenica lunch every Sunday.
facts.excerpt: Join us every Sunday, at Bocconi, for an elegant Pranzo and savour the taste of Italy.

facts.text: Mixologist Salvatore Calabrese created Bar Magritte's menu of 20 cocktails paying homage to Rene Magritte.
facts.excerpt: Salvatore Calabrese has dreamt up a menu of 20 unique cocktails

facts.text: Bar Magritte offers chess, live music and late nights.
facts.excerpt: A space for candlelit conversations and chess, live music and late nights.

facts.text: Le Joueur Gourmand is an afternoon tea that adds a touch of Belgian surrealism to the British tradition, inspired by Magritte's fascination with chess.
facts.excerpt: Le Joueur Gourmand infuses the beloved British afternoon tea tradition with a touch of Belgian surrealism

facts.text: The Tintin Suite invites guests of every age into Herge's world.
facts.excerpt: the Tintin Suite invites guests of every age into Hergé's world

facts.text: In the Diane von Furstenberg Suite's walk-in wardrobe, guests can try on two DVF wrap dresses.
facts.excerpt: In the walk-in wardrobe, two iconic DVF wrap dresses are yours to try on

facts.text: The Blaton Suite has a private terrace overlooking the Grand-Place.
facts.excerpt: the Blaton Suite sits above the city's rooftops with elegant entertaining spaces and a private terrace overlooking the Grand-Place

facts.text: The Presidential Suite is inspired by Rene Magritte's wit and imagination.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by René Magritte's wit and imagination, the Presidential Suite

facts.text: Classic Rooms overlook the hotel's courtyard.
facts.excerpt: Overlooking the hotel's tranquil courtyard, our light-filled Classic Rooms

facts.text: Deluxe Rooms look out over the cobblestone streets of the Old Town.
facts.excerpt: Looking out over the cobblestone streets of the Old Town, our Deluxe Rooms

facts.text: The Family Room has two interconnecting bedrooms, separate bathrooms and family amenities.
facts.excerpt: the Family Room offers two interconnecting bedrooms, separate bathrooms and thoughtful family amenities

facts.text: Individual or group running tours of Brussels are available on request through the concierge.
facts.excerpt: Individual or group Running Tours are available upon request. Please contact the concierge for further information.

facts.text: The Fitness Centre has Technogym equipment and a full set of free weights.
facts.excerpt: Our Fitness Centre has a suite of state-of-the-art Technogym equipment and full set of free weights

facts.text: There is no dress code, but the hotel asks guests not to wear sportswear, shorts or beach shoes in its restaurants.
facts.excerpt: refrain from wearing sportswear, shorts and beach shoes in our restaurants

facts.text: Forte Suite benefits include a return airport transfer.
facts.excerpt: Return transfer to/from the airport

facts.text: Hotel Amigo was named in Conde Nast Traveler's Readers' Choice Awards in 2026.
The hotel calls Ristorante Bocconi Belgium's best Italian restaurant.
facts.excerpt: best Italian restaurant
